task_description: Switch vcpkg triplet from x64-windows to x64-windows-static-md so all third-party libraries (imgui, tesseract, sqlite3, leptonica, nlohmann-json) are statically embedded into our DLLs. This eliminates the need for any extra DLLs beyond d3d11.dll and bronco_ocr.dll.

verification.summary: Cannot build on Linux host (requires MSVC + vcpkg on Windows). Validated via YAML/JSON syntax checking and consistency verification of triplet string across all files.
